_note: Reviews and testimonials are sample content. Campaigns and stories are sourced from the Official CPU CBA Facebook page.

reviews.name: Maria Clara
reviews.body: The finance subjects are challenging but very practical. Our Credit and Collection and Capital Markets classes used real Philippine cases.

reviews.name: Nathaniel Santos
reviews.body: Business Plan Implementation is where everything clicked. We ran an actual food stall on campus for a whole semester.

reviews.name: Danica Cruz
reviews.body: The professors know the industry well. I wish there were more digital marketing electives, but E-Commerce and Internet Marketing was great.

reviews.name: Reynaldo Reyes
reviews.body: It's heavy on accounting, but the structure is clear and the faculty really push you. JPAMA activities are a highlight.

reviews.name: Althea Buan
reviews.body: Recruitment and Selection and Labor Relations gave me confidence going into my internship at a BPO HR department.

reviews.name: Jerome Dalisay
reviews.body: I came from STEM, and the bridging subjects helped me catch up quickly. Classmates and teachers are very welcoming.

testimonials.quote: CBA taught me that numbers tell stories, and that integrity is what makes people trust the story you tell.
testimonials.name: Angel Locsin

testimonials.quote: I started my business plan in third year. Today it employs six people in my hometown.
testimonials.name: Juanito Aquino

testimonials.quote: The 600-hour internship opened the door to my first job before I even graduated.
testimonials.name: Juan Luna

campaigns.title: Official Directory: CBA Student Council A.Y. 2026–2027
campaigns.body: Get to know the leaders ready to serve, listen, and take action for every student. The official directory includes names, positions, and contact details. Whether you have academic concerns, event proposals, or need student support, the College of Business and Accountancy Student Council is here to listen and act.

campaigns.title: PHONE-NIX: Your Direct Line to Official CBA Updates
campaigns.body: Stay connected with everything happening in the College of Business and Accountancy through PHONE-NIX, the official broadcast channel of CBA. Receive timely announcements, event updates, and important council communications through Messenger Channels.

campaigns.title: Happening Now: CBA Town Hall Meeting
campaigns.body: The College of Business and Accountancy Provincial Council is holding a Town Hall Meeting to provide a platform for open communication, raise student concerns, share important updates, and discuss matters concerning the CBA community.

campaigns.title: Phoenix Treats x Avocadoria: ₱20 Off Voucher
campaigns.body: After the exams, Phoenix Treats x Avocadoria offered CBA students a ₱20 off voucher at the NV Lobby on October 23, 2026, starting at 1:00 PM. One voucher per CBA student, first come, first served while supplies lasted.

campaigns.title: Investor Education Webinar
campaigns.body: The Securities and Exchange Commission Iloilo Extension Office invites the CBA community to an Investor Education Webinar on October 29, 2026, at 9:00 AM. The session focuses on financial literacy, wise money management, and informed financial decisions.

campaigns.title: BSMA Pa Rin sa Pasko
campaigns.body: Central Philippine University - JPAMA is taking over Pixie Hollow with a holiday entry built around perseverance: “BSMA pa rin sa Pasko.” The entry was adapted from “Tuloy na tuloy pa rin ang Pasko.”
